title: @export_storage serializing Node not as NodePath but as full data
body:
### Tested versions

- Reproducible in 4.3.stable, v4.4.beta1

### System information

Godot v4.4.beta1 - macOS Sequoia (15.1.1) - Multi-window, 1 monitor - Metal (Mobile) - integrated Apple M3 Pro (Apple9) - Apple M3 Pro (12 threads)

### Issue description

When serializing a Node with `@export` a node gets serialized as NodePath but when exported as @export_storage the whole node data gets serialized into the scene.

This might be the same bug as [#95923](https://github.com/godotengine/godot/issues/95923) but I'm not sure


### Steps to reproduce

Here is a simple code that reproduces the bug. Code only works in 4.4, only to have a simple button in the code to demonstrate the bug without an plugin. I have also added this as a small sample below

```
@tool
extends Node

@export var node: Node
@export_storage var node_storage: Node

@export_tool_button("Test") var test = create_node

func create_node()->void:
    var new_node = Node.new()
    new_node.name = "Test"
    add_child(new_node)
    new_node.owner = get_tree().root
    node = new_node
    node_storage = new_node
    notify_property_list_changed()
```

This results in this in the scene file which i guess is wrong:
```
node = NodePath("Test")
node_storage = Object(Node,"_import_path":NodePath(""),"unique_name_in_owner":false,"process_mode":0,"process_priority":0,"process_physics_priority":0,"process_thread_group":0,"physics_interpolation_mode":0,"auto_translate_mode":0,"editor_description":"","script":null)
```
